messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: High tail latency on /v1/generate-prod (prod, us-west-2). Alert 9821. 95th token latency jumped from ~120ms -> ~900ms over last 10m. Paging eng-oncall.
Sam C: I'm on it, looking at traces now. Can someone post current traffic shape? suspicious of large batches filling GPU queues.
Olivia R: grabbing metrics: 99th token latency spike lines up with increased continuous_batching batch_window usage. 10m window: batch_window_ms distribution shifted to 60-80ms from usual 20-30ms.
Mei H: confirmed. We also see average batch sizes up ~2.5x for the past 12m. A few tenants spiked with long-context requests.
Dmitri K: any recent deploys to routing or batching? infra-bot, any config rollouts in last 30m?
infra-bot: Deploybot: No batching/routing config rollouts in the last 60m. Latest deploy to runtime was 3h ago (rev r-2026-03-15-06). No config changes.
Sam C: OK. hypothesis: traffic pattern change -> batching adapts -> big batches -> head-of-line queues -> tail latency. We should apply live mitigations: tighten batch window and cap max batch tokens for prod route to trade throughput for latency.
Olivia R: +1. Proposed quick mitigations:
- set continuous_batching.batch_window_ms = 12 (was 50)
- set continuous_batching.max_batch_tokens = 1024 (was 4096)
- apply per-route soft QPS caps for public tier (reduce non-critical tenants)
Mei H: I'll execute a conservative change first: drop batch_window_ms to 25 and set max_batch_tokens to 2048, observe for 2m, then further drop if no regressions. Safer.
Sam C: Do it. Please also add a temporary per-tenant rate limit for the top 5 noisy tenants: 50 qps each.
Mei H: executing now. Pasting the change and command (internal tool):
```
redwoodctl config apply --route /v1/generate-prod \
  --patch '{"continuous_batching":{"batch_window_ms":25,"max_batch_tokens":2048}}'
```
Mei H: also issuing per-tenant throttle via traffic-shaper:
```
traffic-shaper set --tenant-id t-23,t-45,t-90 --qps 50 --duration 15m --reason "live mitigation: batching tail latency"
```
Olivia R: seeing batch_window median drop from ~48 -> ~26ms within 30s. 95th token latency trending down from 900ms -> 340ms. :thumbsup:
Sam C: good. Mei, can you stage a second change if latency doesn't fall below 250ms in next 3m? Lower to 12ms / 1024 tokens.
Mei H: will do. Also tagging runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/batching-tail-latency
Dmitri K: we should warn SRE/SEs to expect throughput degradation. Post a short note in #general-ops so customers on Dedicated know we are changing batching to preserve P99 latency.
Sam C: on it.
Sam C (to #general-ops): deploying live mitigation for prod generate route; reducing batch window and capping batch tokens to reduce tail latency. Expect throughput drop ~10-30% for long-context workloads. Rolling changes over 5m.
Olivia R: FYI we also observed a small increase in token error rate for one GPU pool ~0.5% correlated with huge batch sizes; might be queue timeouts. Mitigation should help.
Mei H: applying second step now (if needed):
```
redwoodctl config apply --route /v1/generate-prod \
  --patch '{"continuous_batching":{"batch_window_ms":12,"max_batch_tokens":1024}}' --apply-if "p99_latency>300"
```
Olivia R: p99 now at 260ms after step1. trending downward. no increase in errors. Good signal.
Sam C: ok hold at step1 for now. Re-evaluate in 10 minutes. I will page sales/support to prepare for customer queries.
Dmitri K: preparing a short blurb for Support: "We detected increased tail latency due to sudden traffic patterns; we applied temporary batching window and size limits to restore latency. Some high-context workloads may see reduced throughput for a short period."
Mei H: adding a temporary metric annotation/event so we can correlate during postmortem: event id ev-2401239876-mitigation.
infra-bot: Metric annotation created: ev-2401239876-mitigation
Sam C: timeline so far: alert 00:10, step1 applied 00:13, p99 dropped to 260ms by 00:16. Next check 00:25 for longer-term stability. Oncall handoff to Dmitri at 00:40Z if still stable.
Olivia R: rolling monitor alarms to higher sensitivity while mitigation is active. If p99 creeps >400ms we'll revert or tighten further.
Dmitri K: if we need to revert to higher throughput, we can roll back the config with:
```
redwoodctl config apply --route /v1/generate-prod \
  --patch '{"continuous_batching":{"batch_window_ms":50,"max_batch_tokens":4096}}'
```
Sam C: noted. I'll add a short post-incident note to #postmortems after the event. For now I'll stay on the thread until 00:40Z then handoff.
Mei H: monitoring logs+traces. No customer-facing errors. Support informed. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Sam C: handing off to Dmitri at 00:40Z — leaving ops checklist: mitigation step1 active, traffic-shaper timers expire at 00:28Z, annotation ev-2401239876-mitigation. Dmitri, please escalate to Eng-runtime if p99 > 350ms or error rate >0.8%.
Dmitri K: got it, taking over. ping me directly if anything changes. :ok_hand:
Sam C: Thanks team, great quick coord. Closing pager for now but keeping an eye.
